legacy_threshold: If validation scores separate, max(benign)+0.25*(min(malicious)-max(benign)); otherwise maximize validation TPR-FPR over finite ROC thresholds. Predict using >=. Historical implementation remains in the original project.
shared_threshold: Existing shared_protocol clean-only 5% conformal upper quantile, strict >. This is an explicitly different evaluation protocol, not a replacement of historical results.
